subdivision_of_building: Single storey ground floor extension to the east of the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and changes to internal layout to the first floor House in Multiple Occupancy (C4 use)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [297/P01(I)- Received 09/10/2023; 297/P06(C), 297/P09(B) - Received 06/10/2023; 297/P03(J)- Received 14/09/2023; 297/P01(A), 297/P02(A), 297/P07(A), 297/P08(A), 297/SH01(A), 297/SH02(A) - Received 16/07/2023; 297/S01,  297/S02, 297/S03, 297/S04, 297/S05, 297/S06, 297/S07; Daylight and Sunlight Report (Rev B), Lighting Assessment Report (Rev A), Planning statement (Rev B), Commercial Servicing Statement (Rev A)- Received 16/07/2023; Sustainable Construction Statement, Fire Safety Strategy- Received 03/04/2023].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to occupation, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of all cycle stands for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The approved facilities shall  conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance( or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in numbers, design and layout, and be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the proposed development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 5 - The newly formed premises within the extension hereby approved shall not be used other than for the display or retail sale of goods, other than hot food, principally to visiting members of the public (Use Class Ea) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
